## Detailed Findings

#### 1. SST MCP parallel shutdown #58351 CLI-ACTIONABLE (mcp, shutdown, parallel, error-isolation)

- **What**: SST OpenCode PR #58351 (merged 2026-10-23) moves MCP server shutdown from sequential to parallel with `Promise.allSettled`. Issue: sequential shutdown (`for (const server of servers) { await server.stop() }`) meant one stuck server blocked all subsequent shutdowns, delaying CLI exit or session cleanup. Fix: `await Promise.allSettled(servers.map(s => s.stop()))` shuts down all servers concurrently, isolated failures (one server hanging does not block others), faster cleanup (especially with many MCP servers). Pattern: parallel cleanup with `allSettled` (not `all`) so individual failures are logged but do not reject the whole shutdown.

- **Why**: Alexi MCP system (`src/mcp/`) currently shuts down servers sequentially (audit needed to confirm shutdown loop pattern). SST's parallel shutdown with `Promise.allSettled` offers (1) faster cleanup when multiple MCP servers are active (common with MCP server registry + workspace-specific servers), (2) isolated failure handling (one stuck/failed server does not block CLI exit or session closure), (3) graceful degradation (all servers get shutdown signal, failures logged individually). Implementation: find MCP shutdown code in `src/mcp/`, replace sequential loop with `Promise.allSettled(servers.map(s => s.stop()))`, log individual rejections. Size SMALL ~2-3h (find shutdown code, replace with parallel pattern, add rejection logging, test with multiple MCP servers). Priority LOW (shutdown performance improvement, not user-facing bug, current sequential shutdown works but slower).

- **Source**: https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58351 (MCP parallel shutdown upstream, merged 2026-10-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/mcp/ (Alexi MCP system, audit needed for current shutdown pattern)

- **Category**: mcp (shutdown, parallel, error-isolation)

- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h. Audit MCP shutdown code, replace sequential loop with `Promise.allSettled`, add rejection logging, test with multiple MCP servers. Priority LOW (performance improvement, not critical bug).

#### 2. Kilocode security hardening 2026-10-23 REFERENCE-ONLY (security, certificates, oauth, cache-ownership)

- **What**: Kilocode releases v7.8.16 and v7.8.17 (2026-10-23) focus on security hardening: (1) Blocked compromised eMudhra certificates (Bun SSL security update, `fix(cli): block compromised eMudhra certificates`), (2) Pinned Bun 1.4.4 for certificate fix (`chore(cli): pin Bun 1.4.4 for the certificate fix`), (3) Restricted browser and MCP OAuth URLs to HTTP(S) only (`fix(cli): restrict browser and MCP OAuth URLs to HTTP(S)`, prevent `file://`, `javascript:`, etc. schemes), (4) Cache ownership validation without passwd lookups (`fix(cli): validate cache ownership without passwd lookups`, safer file permission checks). All security-focused (certificate revocation list update, URL scheme validation, file ownership checks), no new user-facing features.

- **Why**: Alexi security audit REFERENCE-ONLY. Pattern: (1) Certificate revocation - if Alexi uses Bun or Node.js native TLS, ensure CA cert lists are current (Bun auto-updates, Node.js depends on system CA store). (2) OAuth URL validation - Alexi browser tool (`src/tool/tools/browser.ts`) and MCP OAuth should validate redirect URLs (allow only `http:`, `https:` schemes, block `file:`, `javascript:`, `data:`). (3) Cache ownership - Alexi cache dirs (`~/.alexi/`, session storage) should check ownership matches process UID (prevent symlink attacks, privilege escalation). Current priority SKIP (no known security issue in Alexi, no user report). Pattern reference for future security audit: validate OAuth URLs, check cache ownership, keep runtime CA certs current.

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.16 (Kilocode v7.8.16 upstream, 2026-10-23), https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.17 (Kilocode v7.8.17 upstream, 2026-10-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/browser.ts (Alexi browser tool, OAuth redirect validation audit needed), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/mcp/ (Alexi MCP system, OAuth URL validation audit needed)

#### 3. Cline run health telemetry #15228 REFERENCE-ONLY (telemetry, stall-diagnostics, run-health, observer)

- **What**: Cline PR #15228 (merged 2026-10-23) adds per-run stall signals for harness reliability measurement. Issue: stall diagnosis required manual transcript inspection (no telemetry signal for run health, no measure of response-time gaps). Fix: `RunHealthObserver` in core watches runtime events (tool-call-delta, tool-result, text-chunk, turn-end), measures longest gap between events and what preceded it (e.g. longest silence after tool-result), reports finish reason + final message shape + text signature of final text-only turn. Fields added to `agent.run-finished` / `agent.run-failed` telemetry via `runEndTelemetryProperties` hook (sessionId, isSubagent, providerId, modelId for grouping/pairing, longestGapMs, eventBeforeGap, finishReason, textSignature). No message text sent (only signature). Pairs with `session.input_sent` (gains agentBusy, msSinceTurnEnd, bumpKind for user reaction). Tool-argument streaming now emits `tool-call-delta` progress event (per-second throttle). Pattern: core observer watches runtime events, tracks longest gap, emits stall fields on run-end telemetry, no message content, pairs with user input via session/model/provider IDs.

- **Why**: Alexi telemetry (`src/providers/langfuse-telemetry.ts`) does not track per-run stall signals (no longest-gap measurement, no runtime event observer, no run-health telemetry). REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi adds harness-stall measurement (e.g. for debugging stuck runs, measuring response-time gaps between tool calls, identifying slow tools), reference this pattern: (1) Core observer (`RunHealthObserver` or equivalent) watches runtime events (tool-call, tool-result, text-chunk, turn-end), (2) Track longest gap between events and event type before gap (e.g. 45s silence after tool-result = slow tool), (3) Emit stall fields on run-end telemetry (`agent.run-finished`, `agent.run-failed`) via hook (sessionId, providerId, modelId, longestGapMs, eventBeforeGap, finishReason), (4) No message text sent (privacy), only signature for final text-only turn, (5) Pair with user input telemetry (`session.input_sent` gains agentBusy, msSinceTurnEnd, bumpKind for user reaction after stall). Benefits: harness stalls measurable from telemetry instead of transcripts, can group by model/provider/tool, can measure user reaction (did user bump the agent after long gap). Current priority SKIP (Alexi telemetry focuses on cost/usage, no stall-diagnosis requirement). Pattern reference for future harness reliability measurement.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15228 (run health telemetry upstream, merged 2026-10-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/langfuse-telemetry.ts (Alexi telemetry, no per-run stall signals), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/orchestrator.ts (Alexi orchestrator, no runtime event observer for stall tracking)

- **Category**: N/A (telemetry, stall-diagnostics, run-health, observer, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi telemetry does not track run-health stalls. Pattern reference for future harness reliability measurement (add runtime event observer, track longest gaps, emit on run-end telemetry).

#### 4. Cline desktop Hub startup reliability #15130 REFERENCE-ONLY (desktop, hub, startup, sidecar, retry, diagnostics)

- **What**: Cline PR #15130 (merged 2026-10-23) improves desktop Hub startup reliability. Issue: Desktop sidecar ran Hub setup before starting server, so Hub failure left webview with nothing to connect to (confusing "backend not ready" errors). Fix: (1) Start sidecar server first, publish endpoint, then run Hub setup (login-shell PATH, bundled CLI `hub ensure`, session manager) in background. (2) Hub status (starting, ready, failed) broadcast as `hub_status` and replayed to new connections. (3) Setup not finished after 30s reports failure but keeps running (slow Hub still completes). (4) `retry_hub` command retries failed startup. (5) Startup screen shows spinner (starting), Retry + Export diagnostics (failed), or Reload (backend unreachable 30s). (6) App mounts when Hub ready, stays mounted, covered with React Activity on later failures (keeps open conversations, releases focus traps). Pattern: start server first, run setup in background, broadcast status, show startup screen with retry/diagnostics on failure, keep app state through failures.

- **Why**: Alexi is CLI-only (no desktop app, no local Hub, no sidecar, no webview). SKIP. Pattern reference if Alexi adds desktop app or web UI with local background service: start server first, run setup in background, broadcast status, show startup screen with retry/diagnostics on failure.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15130 (desktop Hub startup reliability upstream, merged 2026-10-23), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Alexi architecture, CLI-only, no desktop app)

- **Category**: N/A (desktop, hub, startup, sidecar, retry, diagnostics, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi CLI-only, no desktop app. Pattern reference for future desktop app with local background service.

#### 6. SST ChatGPT context caps plugin #58194 REFERENCE-ONLY (provider, plugin, context-caps, chatgpt, extensibility)

- **What**: SST OpenCode PR #58194 (merged 2026-10-23) moves ChatGPT context-window caps into separate plugin. Issue: core provider hardcoded ChatGPT context limits (128k window, 16k output cap). Fix: extracted context caps into `chatgpt-context-caps` plugin (out of core provider). Pattern: provider-specific context limits as plugins instead of hardcoded in core, enables per-provider context strategies (e.g. custom compaction rules, different buffer sizes, model-specific caps).

- **Why**: Alexi providers (`src/providers/`) have context limits in provider classes (e.g. `src/providers/openai-compatible.ts`, `src/providers/bedrock-model-id.ts`). REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi moves to plugin-based provider extensions (e.g. per-provider context strategies, custom compaction rules, model-specific caps as plugins), reference this pattern: (1) Extract context-cap logic from core provider into plugin, (2) Plugin registers context-cap function (takes model ID, returns max input/output tokens), (3) Core provider calls plugin function instead of hardcoded limits, (4) Benefits: provider-specific strategies without core changes, easier to add new models, testable in isolation. Current priority SKIP (Alexi context limits work well in provider classes, no plugin extensibility requirement). Pattern reference for future provider plugin system.

- **Source**: https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58194 (ChatGPT context caps plugin upstream, merged 2026-10-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/ (Alexi providers, context limits in provider classes), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/plugin/ (Alexi plugin system, file-based, not provider-extension plugins)

- **Category**: N/A (provider, plugin, context-caps, chatgpt, extensibility, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi context limits in provider classes work well. Pattern reference for future provider plugin extensibility (per-provider context strategies, model-specific caps as plugins).

#### 7. SST background compaction rename #58294 REFERENCE-ONLY (compaction, naming, clarity, background)

- **What**: SST OpenCode PR #58294 (merged 2026-10-23) renames `precompute_compaction` to `background_compaction` and documents it. Issue: `precompute_compaction` flag name was unclear (precompute what? when?). Fix: renamed to `background_compaction` (compaction runs in background before hitting context limit, vs on-demand compaction when limit hit). Pattern: clear naming for background/preemptive features vs on-demand/reactive features.

- **Why**: Alexi compaction (`src/core/compaction.ts`) does not have precompute/background flag (compaction triggered on-demand when context limit approached, no preemptive background compaction). REFERENCE-ONLY: if Alexi adds background compaction (e.g. compact conversation in background worker before context limit hit, preemptive summarization), reference this naming pattern: `background_compaction` (not `precompute_compaction`) for clarity. Current priority SKIP (Alexi on-demand compaction works well, no background compaction). Pattern reference for future background compaction feature.

- **Source**: https://github.com/sst/opencode/pull/58294 (background compaction rename upstream, merged 2026-10-23), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/compaction.ts (Alexi compaction, on-demand only, no background flag)

- **Category**: N/A (compaction, naming, clarity, background, reference-only)

- **Size**: SKIP. Alexi compaction on-demand only. Pattern reference for future background compaction naming.
